name: jlcpcb
description: Parts orderable from LCSC and assembled by JLCPCB (basic parts where possible); LCSC numbers verified 2026-09-05

capacitor-0603.description: MLCC 0603. Give the LCSC part for the value, e.g. 100n=C14663 (YAGEO CC0603KRX7R9BB104, 50 V X7R, basic), 1u=C15849

capacitor-0805.description: MLCC 0805. Give the LCSC part for the value, e.g. 10u=C15850 (Samsung CL21A106KAYNNNE, 25 V X5R, basic)

led-0603-red.description: Red 0603 chip LED, KENTO KT-0603R, Vf 1.8–2.4 V (LCSC C2286, JLCPCB basic part)

ne555dr.description: Texas Instruments NE555DR precision timer, SOIC-8, 4.5–16 V (LCSC C7593, JLCPCB basic part); behavioural SPICE model

resistor-0603.description: Chip resistor 0603, 1%, 100 mW. Give the LCSC part for the value you use, e.g. 10k=C25804, 100k=C25803, 330=C23138, 1k=C21190 (JLCPCB basic parts)

solder-pads-2.description: Two exposed pads to solder supply wires to (+ and -); no part is placed, excluded from BOM/pick-and-place

led-duris-e-2835-cri90.description: OSRAM DURIS E 2835 GW JTLPS1.CM white LED, CRI 90 min / 92 typ, R9>=50, 150 mA nominal (250 mA max), Vf 2.70-3.30 V (2.94 typ), Rth 25 K/W. Stocked variant: 6500 K (LCSC C17297932); other CCTs of the same part use the same footprint

mosfet-aod482.description: AOS AOD482 N-channel MOSFET, 100 V, 32 A, 42 mΩ @ 4.5 V, Vgs(th) 1.6-2.7 V, TO-252 (LCSC C89735); fine as a linear current sink at ~1 W on an aluminium board

mosfet-2n7002.description: JSCJ 2N7002 N-channel MOSFET, 60 V, 115 mA, Vgs(th) 1-2.5 V, SOT-23 pins 1=G 2=S 3=D (LCSC C8545, JLCPCB basic)

cj431-sot23.description: JSCJ CJ431 adjustable shunt reference 2.495 V (TL431 equivalent), SOT-23 with pins 1=REF 2=CATHODE 3=ANODE (note: NOT the TI pinout); Ika min 1 mA (LCSC C3113, JLCPCB basic)

lm358-soic8.description: onsemi LM358DR2G dual op-amp, 3-32 V single supply, SOIC-8: 1 OUT1, 2 IN1-, 3 IN1+, 4 GND, 5 IN2+, 6 IN2-, 7 OUT2, 8 VCC (LCSC C7950, JLCPCB basic); behavioural model 100 dB, 1 MHz GBW, output swings to VCC-1.5 V

zener-bzt52c10.description: BZT52C10 zener 10 V 500 mW, SOD-123, pad 1 = cathode (LCSC C216719 Shikues)

resistor-1206.description: Chip resistor 1206, 250 mW, 200 V. LCSC per value: 3.3k=C26032 (UNI-ROYAL), 3.3Ω=C137283 (YAGEO RC1206FR-073R3L)

capacitor-1206.description: MLCC 1206. LCSC per value: 1u/100V X7R = C13832 (Samsung CL31B105KCHNNNE)

resistor-0805.description: Chip resistor 0805, 125 mW. LCSC per value: 0Ω jumper = C17477 (UNI-ROYAL, JLCPCB basic)

wago-2060-452.description: WAGO 2060-452/998-404 SMD push-in terminal block, 2 poles, 4 mm pitch, 24-18 AWG, 9 A / 63 V (IEC III/3); JLCPCB stocks it (C2765055) but it is marked hand-soldered (assembly: false) — set metadata.assembly true if you want JLCPCB to place it

al5809-60.description: Diodes AL5809-60P1-7 two-terminal 60 mA (±5%) constant-current LED regulator, 2.5-60 V across IN-OUT, PowerDI-123, 1.24 W on a good pad (LCSC C154921). Parallel several for more current; PWM 100-200 Hz via a low-side MOSFET on OUT (0.5 ms min on/off)
